title: momino me hai hashr ek bapa
body:
momino me hai hashr ek bapa binte fatima kar gayi qaza
haaye pusht par belcha laga binte fatima kar gayi qaza
dete the layi'n dukh jise sada, joro zulm ki thi na intehaa
qaahare hussain jaane mustafa, binte fatima kar gayi qaza
<<DIVIDER>>
karte the buka abide hazee'n, haaye aye phupi tum bhi chal basi
dukh zado'n ka haaye ab koi nahi, binte fatima kar gayi qaza
zulm ye kiye baanie jafa, phir dobaara haaye qaid kar diya
marke hogayi qaid se reha, binte fatima kar gayi qaza
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid se chuti kunbe se chuti, balwe me phiri berida hui
shehre shaam me jaake mar gayi, binte fatima kar gayi qaza
baandhe the layee'n tumko reesmaa'n, baade marg bhi jiske the nishaa'n
pusht par bhi the durro ke nishaa'n , binte fatima kar gayi qaza
